title: AssetSpec
description: One asset, fully described. Everything needed to regenerate it from art/generators at a commit. Fields not listed here are rejected. Every field has a default except id, class, archetype and source.

spec_version.description: Format version of this file. Bumped when a field changes meaning; the resolver refuses a version it does not know.

id.description: The asset id: the filename, the manifest key, the glTF scene name and the TypeScript identifier. Never changes.

class.description: Asset class. Decides the budget row, the required clips and the id pattern.

archetype.description: The game archetype (swarm, runner, tank; single, splash, slow) or, for the other classes, a free label used in lineups.

tier.description: Creep tier 1 to 3. Tier 1 is the sim's tier index 0.

derived_from.description: Id of the spec this one inherits from. Inheritance is a deep merge: objects merge key by key, scalars and arrays in this spec replace the parent's. Chains resolve recursively; cycles are an error.

body_plan.description: A body plan from art/generators/registry.json, or "imported" for an external model.

params.description: Body-plan parameters. Names, defaults and ranges come from the registry; spec-validate checks them. `parts` is the list of part-library pieces to attach, each a name or {part, at, scale}.

at.description: Attachment point name; the part's default when omitted.

palette.description: Palette role the part is painted with: primary, secondary, accent, glow or trim.
Colour roles, each a palette name from the style sheet (or an alias like creep_skin_2).

glow.description: Emissive colour for glow-slot geometry (eyes, crystals). Null for none.

tier_shift.description: Fraction the primary is blended toward the accent. The style sheet's tier language sets 0 / 0.25 / 0.5.

trim.description: Whether the gold tier-3 trim and emissive strip are present.

team_mask.description: Material slots painted white in the team-colour mask. Slot names come from the body plan and parts.

rig.description: Rig template from the registry, or null for an unrigged asset (projectiles, effects, tiles, props).

animations.description: Clip name (from the animation contract) to the animation generator that produces it, with its parameters.

duration.description: Seconds. The generator's default when omitted.

stride.description: Walk only: tiles covered per cycle if the creature moved, for the client's timeScale.

markers.description: Normalised times of contract markers (fire, land, impact).

audio.description: Event name to sound id. Events not listed fall back to the archetype's default in the binding table.

game.description: PROPOSED game-data entry. Never applied by the factory; handed to /rule-change. Free-form, keyed like the constants file.

import.description: Only when body_plan is "imported": where the external model is and how to bring it to the conventions.

scale.description: Multiplier applied before fitting to the class's height range. 0 means fit automatically.

forward.description: Which axis of the source file faces forward.

retarget.description: Rig template to retarget the file's own clips onto, or null to bake procedural clips from `animations` onto the file's rig.

clip_map.description: Source clip name to contract clip name, for files that carry their own animation.

source.description: Provenance and licence. Required; the gate refuses a build without it.

attribution.description: Required for cc-by: the exact line that goes in LICENSES.md.

service.description: For ai and paid sources: the service or vendor.

terms.description: For ai, paid and other: a pointer to the terms.

approved_by.description: Required before an ai, freelance or other-licence asset ships.
